answer_1.quote: In this paper, we present LightThinker, a new approach to enhance the efficiency of LLMs in complex reasoning tasks by dynamically compressing intermediate thoughts during generation.
answer_1.outputs: intermediate thoughts and final answers in reasoning tasks

answer_2.quote: For effectiveness, we use accuracy as the evaluation metric (Acc); for efficiency, we employ three metrics: inference time (Time), the peak number of tokens in the context during inference (Peak), and the sum of dependency of each generated token on previous tokens during the generation (Dep).

answer_3.quote: Distill-R1 performs worse than CoT across all datasets because its weaker instruction-following ability prevents effective answer extraction using rules, even with attempts at evaluation using an LLM evaluator.
